cohort: Neonates admitted to the Special Care Newborn Unit (SCANU) at Chittagong Medical College Hospital from July 2017 to December 2017, comparing those discharged against medical advice (DAMA) with those routinely discharged.
finding: Preterm gestation, vaginal delivery, timing of outcome after office hours and on weekends, sepsis, Respiratory Distress Syndrome, prematurity without other complications, and referral from north-western districts were predictors of DAMA.
mod_finding: Vaginal delivery was a predictor of DAMA (AOR 1.56, 95% CI 1.31-1.86, p < 0.001).
gest_age: Term and preterm neonates were included.
birth_weight: Standard weight and other weights at admission were included.
